Take a look at my danmaku!

You might feel a little jolt...

Just gotta buy time til I can escape...

I'll do my best to help!
No one's getting hurt on my watch!
I'll do whatever I can to help!
We can swap whenever you need it!
Let's show them our serious danmaku!
I'll do my best to help!

Lady Makura/ I'm right here with you!

I'll do whatever I can/ Lady Makura!
I'll do my best/ Lady Makura!

Huh? I was expecting that to hurt...
Were you/ um... not trying/ or something?
It's like a bug bit me!
Uh oh/ this is looking bad!
Oh no! What do I do now...?
I can dodge danmaku/ easy peasy!
I can at least dodge that much!
Like a lamb to the slaughter!
The early bird gets the worm/ sleepyhead!
I guess I'm no good at this after all...
I'll defeat you/ for Lady Makura's sake!
You might look like Lady Makura/ but I won't hesitate!
Shitone...\n　I don't care how weird your danmaku is! Bring it on!
I can protect Lady Makura! Just you wait and see!
Okay Mehko... keep your eyes peeled!
I'm honestly not that good at fighting...
Alright/ I'll give this danmaku my best shot...!
Take a look at my danmaku!
I'll channel my feelings/ into my danmaku...!
I'll give it my best shot!
I'm not going to hesitate anymore...
The old me entrusted me with this!
This power I borrowed from Lady Makura...
